main_body: A palm tree: a curved tan trunk with a green fronded canopy drooping around the top
top_band: Canopy crown at rows 0-10 in light-to-mid greens reads as a top mass seen from above, with drooping fronds below; the trunk below it is a vertical form
evidence: Organic palm: the canopy has a lighter top crown (rows 2-10) with fronds that droop down and cast darker shade at their undersides, and the trunk runs below it for about 28 rows. It reads as a canopy seen from above with a trunk, not a flat elevation, so it is acceptable for an organic object.

style.evidence: The candidate has a nearly black outline around both fronds and trunk, a sticker look, whereas the Beodeul trees use dark green and brown tones for separation. The canopy has about 4 greens and the trunk has 3-4 tans with only a ring pattern. Foliage is smooth and lacks the leaf clumps and dotted texture of the references, so tile density is much lower than the rich reference trees. It also looks thin and simplified next to them.
